drum_patterns.comment: 16 steps per bar, step 0 = downbeat. [step, velocity, optional lane]. Ghost notes ride low. Busts and fills are generated from bust_bars.

in_space_measured.comment: Measured transcription, not an authored groove: demucs htdemucs drums stem of the in_space canon row (render_evidence/measured_canon.json), 16-slot best-phase grid over 39 bars, velocities = measured onset strengths. The backbeat peaks at slots 2/3 and 10 rather than 4/12 - that drunk placement is what the analyzer measured, phase-locked per its own +/-45 ms window; pair with the in_space groove profile, which carries the +17.7 ms off-8th lateness the flat grid cannot.

in_space.comment: Measured accents: downbeat kick, kick trailing the snare, late snare, sparse dark hats.

groove_profiles.comment: spread_ms = per-hit timing jitter sigma; nudge = fixed offsets ms; drag = whole-loop lateness; velocity wobble is performer-owned.

in_space.comment: Measured from the in_space canon row: swing position 52.7%, off-8th residual +17.7 ms LATE (slots 2/6/10/14 drag), on-grid share 0.67. The step offsets carry the measured lateness the swing percent cannot express; keep them together.

kits.comment: Per-drum synth controls: tune (semitones), decay (s), tone 0-1 (brightness), crush (bits), level, pan (-1..1).

comment: Production profiles are intent presets. The Flying Lotus profile is an original jazz-fusion/electronic study, not a claimed transcription of a specific track. The royksopp profile is a separate melodic synth-pop lane built around the Dusty Paradise six-chord study, a steady electronic pulse and a slow Juno ensemble patch.

arc.status: historical authored arrangement heuristics; not measured listener preferences

craft_research.status: historical research, not newly verified acoustic measurements
mechanisms: Independent but repeatable timing lanes; no universal golden-ratio swing.
Compose chops into phrases; do not copy protected samples or melodies.
Motifs, voice leading, question and answer, silence and foreground changes carry the form.
Select complementary source timbres before filtering, saturation or mastering.
Preserve kick envelope, headroom and transient detail while selectively wearing other layers.
Compare timing and arrangement controls with level-matched listening.
measurement_limits: Tempo disagreement and half/double-time ambiguity are explicit.
Full-mix envelopes cannot identify instrument-specific onset or swing.
Band energy is not isolated kick or hat measurement; separated stems may bleed.
Onset density, spectral balance and crest factor are technical evidence, not beauty.
Historical reference mixes were not sample-accurately measured by the cited study; do not promote its hypotheses to ground truth.
superseded: Universal 54.2% golden-ratio swing and indiscriminate large random offsets are historical hypotheses, not defaults.
Do not replace measured canon with old preset numbers.
